question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
What do you think of Matteo?
Have you ever dated someone from another country?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Horrible... I don't know if I can survive another day like that.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Oh dear... Perhaps I need to call the school and have a little talk with the administration.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Don't worry, $ZOE. I'll take care of everything!
That night at home...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: So... How was your first day at school?

nodes.speaker: French Teacher
nodes.text: Tres bien...

nodes.speaker: French Teacher
nodes.text: But I believe your name is $ZOE, correct?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Yeah. But there was this girl Amanda at my old school who always said...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Never mind.

nodes.speaker: French Teacher
nodes.text: At any rate, it's a good start! Keep up the good work!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Phew. That was a close one.

nodes.speaker: French Teacher
nodes.text: That's not French!

nodes.speaker: French Teacher
nodes.text: If you're going to succeed in this class, I urge you to spend more time studying...

nodes.speaker: French Teacher
nodes.text: And less time staring at boys.
Matteo flashes $ZOE another smile.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Could I be any more obvious? Now he probably thinks I'm just another star-struck schoolgirl.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just like everyone else around here...

nodes.speaker: French Teacher
nodes.text: That's not French! That's not even a sentence!

nodes.speaker: French Teacher
nodes.text: If you're going to succeed in this class, I urge you to spend more time studying...

nodes.speaker: French Teacher
nodes.text: And less time staring at boys.
Matteo flashes $ZOE another smile.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Could I be any more obvious? Now he probably thinks I'm just another star-struck schoolgirl.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just like everyone else around here...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Try not to stare at those soft lips... Those deep, playful eyes... That...

nodes.speaker: French Teacher
nodes.text: Mademoiselle $ZOE! Have you started the exercise?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Quick! I need to think of something to say in French!

menu.title: Think fast!
menu.text: Think of something to say in French!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sure thing, Angelica.

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: That's `Lady` Angelica to you!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's [color=#3b78e2][i]Lady[/i][/color] Angelica to you!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: Oh, how I miss the company of girls with proper breeding.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Look, I'm not exactly `thrilled` to be partnered with you either, okay?
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, I'm not exactly [color=#3b78e2][i]thrilled[/i][/color] to be partnered with you either, okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just ran over her to get away from Matteo...
$ZOE blows by Matteo and sits in an empty seat next to Angelica.

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: Oh splendid! I was worried I'd have to converse with some commoner.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So... Do you want to be my partner?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Your 'partner'? What a forward question!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: And right after I told you about my girlfriend, too!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait! I didn't mean...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: A joke, signorina. I would be honored to converse with you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh. Hehe. Great.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He's kind of funny...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Che Bella! We already share the common tongue of English... And soon we'll share another.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Share... A tongue?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Exactly. The French tongue.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Right! Yes! Exactly.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's okay, $ZOE... Just keep calm...
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Nice! I got a window desk. Perfect for looking out at the clouds...
Suddenly, $ZOE hears someone sit down at the desk next to her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just keep looking at the clouds, $ZOE. Concentrate on the clouds.
$ZOE reaches into her bag to take out her notebook.
And when she does, a picture of her and Howard flutters out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I forgot I left that there!
Matteo picks up the photo.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: He looks like a very nice boy, signorina. Does he have a name?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: You miss him, don't you? I can tell these things.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I really do.
Matteo turns on his cell phone. The background is a picture of a beautiful Italian girl.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Her name is Adrianna. I've never loved anyone like I love her.
$ZOE and Matteo's conversation is interrupted as the teacher walks into the room.

nodes.speaker: French Teacher
nodes.text: Welcome to beginning French...

nodes.speaker: French Teacher
nodes.text: ...where all of our international students go to learn the finest language in the world!

nodes.speaker: French Teacher
nodes.text: For today's first conversation exercise, you'll need to pick a partner.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I could go with Matteo... Or I could run over to Angelica's desk and ask her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Who do I ask?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I have to admit... I see why the other girls are interested in him.

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: I... I have a confession to make.

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: I, too, have developed an instantaneous crush on him!

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: Funny, charming, smart... And you should have seen how his little brothers looked up to him when his family dropped him off!

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: I was trying to fight it... But one may as well attempt to push the ocean waves, to hold back the wind!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whoa, whoa. I just said he's kind of cute. Not that I...

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: Don't worry, $ZOE. Your secret is safe with me. Just as I hope mine is with you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Yes. I'm putting it in my vault. These lips are sealed.

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: I knew you had a trustworthy face!
The bell rings.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Nice to meet you, Angelica. See you in class!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... I'm not into super-hot soccer players.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I prefer guys with a sense of humor.

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: Actually, Matteo was apparently voted 'most likely to become a stand-up comedian' at his previous school.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh! Well... What I meant was, uh, I like a guy who's... Dedicated to his family.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: My last boyfriend had these two cute little sis...

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: Matteo is the same way! So dedicated to his two little brothers!

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: They were here earlier, and he let each of them pick out one of his electives!

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: Who am I fooling? I `do` like him. And you clearly do as well!
nodes.text_bbcode: Who am I fooling? I [color=#3b78e2][i]do[/i][/color] like him. And you clearly do as well!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait! No! What I `really` want in a guy is... Uh...
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait! No! What I [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] want in a guy is... Uh...

nodes.text: The bell rings.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Phew. Talk about saved by the bell!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So... Yeah... What's going on over there?

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: You're not the only new student here today.

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: See over there? In the center of that crowd of girls? That is `Matteo.`
nodes.text_bbcode: See over there? In the center of that crowd of girls? That is [color=#3b78e2][i]Matteo.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wow! That's like the hottest guy I've ever seen outside of a magazine.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not that looks are the most important thing...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard was so much more than just a cute guy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He always took care of me... Always listened. And he wasn't so bad-looking either.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But still... Wow.

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: I'm afraid I just don't understand some girls' obsession with athletes.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh... He's a football player or something?

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: A `football` player. Yes. Exactly. His older brother played for the Italian `World Mug` team a few years ago.
nodes.text_bbcode: A [color=#3b78e2][i]football[/i][/color] player. Yes. Exactly. His older brother played for the Italian [color=#3b78e2][i]World Mug[/i][/color] team a few years ago.

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: Rumor has it that Matteo himself will go pro right out of high school.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait... `World Mug?` So you mean he plays `soccer?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait... [color=#3b78e2][i]World Mug?[/i][/color] So you mean he plays [color=#3b78e2][i]soccer?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: 'Soccer'? Only Americans call it that.

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: But that's beside the point. What do you think of him?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He's...

nodes.prompt: What do you think of him?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you think of him?

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: I'm not sure who exactly you're referring to!

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: My name is `Lady` Angelica!
nodes.text_bbcode: My name is [color=#3b78e2][i]Lady[/i][/color] Angelica!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Eep!

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: Sigh. I supposed I should have expected as much from an American.

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: Just as classless as the other plebeians around here, acting as giddy as school girls.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... We `are` school girls.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... We [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] school girls.

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: I'm not sure who exactly you're referring to!

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: My name is `Lady` Angelica!
nodes.text_bbcode: My name is [color=#3b78e2][i]Lady[/i][/color] Angelica!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Eep!

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: Sigh. I supposed I should have expected as much from an American.

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: Just as classless as the other plebeians around here, acting as giddy as school girls.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... We `are` school girls.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... We [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] school girls.

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: Finally, someone with a bit of class joins this school!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: I apologize that the other girls are... Distracted at the moment.

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: I'm not sure who exactly you're referring to!

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: My name is `Lady` Angelica!
nodes.text_bbcode: My name is [color=#3b78e2][i]Lady[/i][/color] Angelica!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Eep!

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: Sigh. I supposed I should have expected as much from an American.

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: Just as classless as the other plebeians around here, acting as giddy as school girls.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... We `are` school girls.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... We [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] school girls.

nodes.text: Later that morning...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh oh... I'm not sure I like this place.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It looks like it was designed by the same architect who built Wilson High!
Near the door to the school, a huge crowd of girls is gathered, giggling and screaming.
Only one girl stands apart from the others. She walks up to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: A new student! How lovely!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Hi.

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: 'Angelica' is the name. Technically it would be `Lady` Angelica back in my native England.
nodes.text_bbcode: 'Angelica' is the name. Technically it would be [color=#3b78e2][i]Lady[/i][/color] Angelica back in my native England.

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: Of course, the locals have shown little respect for such titles.

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: I fear their revolutionary tendencies remain intact, centuries after the fall of the local monarchy.

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: At any rate, I am glad to welcome you to 'Le Academie du Renard'.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, thanks...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's been a rough first few days over here...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I'm not going to let it get me down!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I made friends before... I can do it again!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: So you'll try to make a fresh start here in Paris?
$ZOE reaches over and shuts off her computer.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The past is the past...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Paris is my present.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I'm going to make the most of it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's the point of trying to make new friends here?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll just lose them all next time you and Dad decide to move to a new country.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's probably better if I just keep to myself.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll read books, work on my French...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe I'll start knitting... Or doing puzzles... Or collecting antiques?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Those hobbies are fine for a retired old lady.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: But you're still young, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: And it's time you stopped acting like your life is over!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I know you miss your friends back at Centerscore.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: But I know you'll make new ones here if you just give it a try!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You really think so?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I do.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well... I'm not making any promises.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll `try` to give the kids at my new school a chance.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'll [color=#3b78e2][i]try[/i][/color] to give the kids at my new school a chance.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But if I don't like them, I swear, I'm moving to the woods and becoming a hermit.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Sounds like a deal.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Here we go!
After driving for a while, Matteo turns down a side street and pulls to the side of the road.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Very impressive, signorina. You didn't even flinch when I caught air off of that speed bump.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you kidding? That was the best part!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I've always wished that Adrianna had a greater sense of adventure.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's too bad. A life without adventure is just... Boring.
Matteo turns and walks sadly away.
That night...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So... This is my life now. All alone at night. No one to hang out with... Or to even call.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Who would be texting me now?

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: 'Meet me at the football field as soon as you can, signorina.'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Matteo?!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Adrianna is going to kill me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But... But I want to be with you!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: You and every other girl at this school!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Why can't any of you understand? All I really want is a friend!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But you're just so... Hot.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Okay, signorina. We are finished here. Goodbye. Goodbye forever.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Goodbye, sweet Matteo...
A few weeks later...

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: Hear ye, Hear ye. The Matteo Fanclub is officially in session.

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: Please allow me to introduce your new president... $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hello, everyone, and welcome!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: For today's agenda, we'll be discussing several items.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Item One. Our favorite Matteo fashions.

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: Point of order... I stole one of his polo shirts from his locker!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ooo! Let me touch!

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: Hands off, commoner! I stole this fair and square!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But `you` don't love Matteo as much as I do. The shirt is rightfully mine!
nodes.text_bbcode: But [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] don't love Matteo as much as I do. The shirt is rightfully mine!

nodes.text: Soon, the entire meeting has devolved into chaos as a dozen girls tear the shirt to pieces.
This is no way to leave $ZOE!
Clearly you've made some mistakes... Don't make $ZOE suffer for them!
You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

format.pattern: You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: $ZOE... In another life, another existence...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Maybe we could have been perfect for each other.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think so too.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: But in `this` life, `this` reality... We can never be.
nodes.text_bbcode: But in [color=#e23b3b][i]this[/i][/color] life, [color=#e23b3b][i]this[/i][/color] reality... We can never be.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Yes... I miss that too.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: But, though it fills me with guilt to admit it...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: You were always `more` than a friend to me.
nodes.text_bbcode: You were always [color=#e23b3b][i]more[/i][/color] than a friend to me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I `was?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I... I [color=#3b78e2][i]was?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Matteo... Now I... I don't know how I feel. I'm so confused.
The next day at school...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: $ZOE. There you are.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What... Why... Why are you talking to me?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: My signorina... I only wanted to explain why I left you so suddenly yesterday.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: The truth is that for the last few weeks, Adrianna has been getting angrier and angrier with me.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Every time I talk to her, I end up just telling long stories about `you.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Every time I talk to her, I end up just telling long stories about [color=#e23b3b][i]you.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: But as long as I thought you had a boyfriend, it was okay... It meant nothing could ever happen between us.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Once I found out you and Howard were broken up, I just didn't feel like I could be around you anymore.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I didn't think I could trust myself to be alone with you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I understand.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The truth is, Matteo...

options.label: I don't trust myself around you either.

nodes.text: $ZOE clicks on Howard's page...
And finds a bunch of photos of him, Hector, Colt and Brendan in front of a lake!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He looks awfully happy...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess he really is better off without me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I knew I shouldn't have looked at his page.
$ZOE clicks on Sam's page and reads one of Sam's recent posts.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: 'Missing my cuz soooo much!'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She really does miss me!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe I should give her a call.
$ZOE dials Sam's home phone.

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: Hello?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hi, Aunt Cathy... This is $ZOE. Is Sam there?

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: I'm afraid not. She and her friends went on a trip.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She went somewhere on vacation?

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: Yes, they're headed to the lake. Hector's family has a cabin up there... Just lovely this time of year.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I see... I think I'd better go then.
$ZOE hangs up.

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: Oh dear... I hope $ZOE's doing okay.

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: Poor girl sounded so sad!
Back at home...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Is everything okay, sweetie? I haven't seen you look so sad since your first day here.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There's just no use... No use trying anymore.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Every time I get close to someone, I just get hurt.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Well... I'm sure everything will work out. Do you want to talk about it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not really.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: In the old days, when I had a problem like this, I'd always go to Sam or Howard...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe it wouldn't hurt to check in to see how they're doing... Just this once.
$ZOE boots up her computer and starts clicking on her old friends' profiles.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe for now I'll just look at their profile pages... Whose profile should I look at first?

nodes.prompt: Whose profile should I look at first?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Whose profile should I look at first?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I guess I did make a wrong assumption...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: But you never exactly went out of your way to correct me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe I just... Wanted to spend time with you. Maybe I needed a friend.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: So did I, $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: But I don't think you can be that friend for me anymore.
He turns and leaves.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait... Matteo...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't leave me... Don't leave me here all alone.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: You're... Broken up?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I thought you'd be happy.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: When... When did this happen?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess it was... When I left Centerscore?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: You've been single `this whole time?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You've been single [color=#e23b3b][i]this whole time?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry if there was a slight... Misunderstanding.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Apologies, signorina. Is that American slang? Exclusively what?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Exclusively `dating.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Exclusively [color=#3b78e2][i]dating.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: As in... It's okay if I date other guys here in France.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I... I don't think Adrianna is going to be very happy to hear this!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That isn't exactly the reaction I was hoping for.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I'm sorry, $ZOE... I understand that you and Howard aren't 'exclusive'.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: But my heart would break if I heard Adrianna kissed another guy.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: And I know she feels the same way about me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Matteo... Wait... What I actually meant to say was...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Whatever you have to say, signorina... It doesn't matter now.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I'm afraid I must go.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait... Matteo...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't leave me... Don't leave me here all alone.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait a second... I `don't` have a boyfriend...
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait a second... I [color=#3b78e2][i]don't[/i][/color] have a boyfriend...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But can I really tell Matteo? What do I say?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Matteo, the thing about Howard is...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Who knew a garden like this could exist in such a big city?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: It's like you, $ZOE. A colorful flower in the midst of brick and pavement.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aw... Matteo. You really think I'm a 'colorful flower'?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: $ZOE... You're so much more than just that.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Seeing the way you've tried so hard to be happy in your new life here in France...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: It's inspired me to do the same.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aw... That's really sweet of you to say.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Honestly, $ZOE... If you didn't have a boyfriend...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Yes... It can be hard for new things... To measure up to the old.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Is it the same way with people, do you think?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I sometimes wonder... Can any love ever measure up to the first?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: With the first person you love, everything is so fresh and new...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: But what about the second person you're with?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Could the first kiss with that second love be as special?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I don't know.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I wonder...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Let's... Let's talk about something else.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Like...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I'm surprised to hear you say that, signorina...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: You always talk of the past with such fondness...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's true... There are a lot of things I miss.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But there are some things about the present that I actually prefer.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I know what you mean...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just look where we are, Matteo, how amazing this place is!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I thought that's what you'd pick.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hehe. You're getting to know me pretty well.
A little later...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This place is so beautiful!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Surely you had gardens back in your old city, signorina?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, yes. We did have a few parks...

nodes.prompt: We did have a few parks...

options.label: And I miss them every day.
But nothing as beautiful as this.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: We did have a few parks...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Five miles of passageways built out of human bones? Count me in!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I... I had mostly proposed that option as a joke, but... Okay.
A little later...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't expect it to be so... Dark.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Nor did I...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess being alone with Matteo in the dark isn't `so` bad...
nodes.text_bbcode: I guess being alone with Matteo in the dark isn't [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] bad...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe this will actually be fun!
The sound of tiny feet against cobblestones echoes through the darkness.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Something just brushed against my leg!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: That may have been me... Or a `huge rat!`
nodes.text_bbcode: That may have been me... Or a [color=#e23b3b][i]huge rat![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Eek!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: There, there, signorina. There's... Er... Nothing to be scared of.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Even though we `are` underground, in total darkness, surrounded by miles of passages built of human bones.
nodes.text_bbcode: Even though we [color=#e23b3b][i]are[/i][/color] underground, in total darkness, surrounded by miles of passages built of human bones.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Eek!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Eek![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Tell me something... Comforting.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: $ZOE, I...
Matteo holds $ZOE tight.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: $ZOE... If you didn't have a boyfriend...
Later...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Thanks so much for coming with me tonight, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Though I must admit, the art in the Louvre seemed less beautiful with you standing next to it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hehe. Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How can Matteo say stuff like that and still claim we're just 'hanging out'?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just don't understand...
The Louvre 'hang out' is the first of many for $ZOE and Matteo...
They take a trip to the Palace of Versailles, tour the opera house, and buy books at Shlockspeare and Company.
But some of $ZOE's favorite afternoons are ones they spend just walking around the city.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...and after that, Sam and Colt got back together... Again.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I hope to meet your cousin one day, $ZOE. She sounds very... Feisty.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I hope you get to meet her too.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You know, when I first got here, I was feeling pretty down about her moving on and making new friends...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But now I'm starting to understand what it means to move on.
Sometimes, the conversations go on way into the night...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: ...and so then we run the `exact` same corner kick from the other side of the field, but `this` time I pull off the bicycle kick!
nodes.text_bbcode: ...and so then we run the [color=#e23b3b][i]exact[/i][/color] same corner kick from the other side of the field, but [color=#e23b3b][i]this[/i][/color] time I pull off the bicycle kick!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So you won... One-zero?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Actually, no. I scored three more goals in the last five minutes of the game.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I'm so glad you're learning how to talk about soccer!
And then one day...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I was thinking of something a little `unusual` today.
nodes.text_bbcode: I was thinking of something a little [color=#e23b3b][i]unusual[/i][/color] today.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: We could go to the Botanical Gardens... Or the Catacombs. What do you say?
$ZOE reaches her hand out to take Matteo's... But he quickly steps back.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I am afraid there must be some mistake, signorina.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: In Italy, only boyfriends and girlfriends hold hands.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh! Right! Uh... In America, people who are `just friends` do it too!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh! Right! Uh... In America, people who are [color=#3b78e2][i]just friends[/i][/color] do it too!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I see! Apologies, then. I was unaware of the custom.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's wrong with me? He has a girlfriend!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But more and more, I'm starting to wish he didn't...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh! I think I see the 'Mona Lisa' over there!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: A true masterpiece!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: It's so nice to finally meet a girl who can appreciate great art.
Matteo puts an arm around $ZOE as they walk over to see the next painting.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It feels so nice to be held again...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Even if he does have a girlfriend.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Stop! Stop! Stop! Stop! `STOP!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Stop! Stop! Stop! Stop! [color=#3b78e2][i]STOP![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Easy, signorina. We haven't even left the parking lot yet.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry... I didn't mean to freak out.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: You know... Perhaps it would be better if we walked.
An hour later...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are we... Almost... There?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Almost, signorina.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: My poor, blistered feet... I knew I shouldn't have worn my scooter boots.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: It's okay... My feet will heal. And, anyway, we're here!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh good!
After school...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Matteo said to meet him here... But where is he?
Suddenly, $ZOE hears the hum of an engine as Matteo approaches on a motor scooter.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What is that?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Short of a Pherrari, I assure you signorina, these are the finest vehicles made in Italy.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Now, get on, take this helmet, and wrap your arms around me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That... Sounds pretty good.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard would kill me if he saw me riding around on a scooter with some other guy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I remember him telling me how heartbroken he felt when he saw Linda on the back of Kenji's bike...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But... We're broken up... And I have to move on!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Hold on tight, signorina! And just to warn you, I like to go fast.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's okay, $ZOE. Don't freak out. Don't freak out. Don't freak out!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Actually... I think you have the wrong idea.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard and I are broken up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I have a huge crush on you!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: You mean you're single?!
Matteo jumps up.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: If I'd known, I never would have had this conversation with you!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If anything, I think my relationship with Howard is `stronger` now that we're long-distance.
nodes.text_bbcode: If anything, I think my relationship with Howard is [color=#3b78e2][i]stronger[/i][/color] now that we're long-distance.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Really?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Definitely. He was just telling me the other day how confident he is in us staying together.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And how he wouldn't be jealous `at all` if I hung out with other guys over here.
nodes.text_bbcode: And how he wouldn't be jealous [color=#3b78e2][i]at all[/i][/color] if I hung out with other guys over here.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Fantastico! Then there's nothing to stop us from spending time together!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, there's no going back on it now... So much for 'honesty is the best policy'!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: So what do you say, signorina... We meet after school?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I've been wanting to explore Paris, and I could use a partner-in-crime.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Count me in!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I knew you'd see it my way!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: And you'll be glad to know that Adrianna is a `huge` fan of you.
nodes.text_bbcode: And you'll be glad to know that Adrianna is a [color=#e23b3b][i]huge[/i][/color] fan of you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You told her about me?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Of course. When I told her that I met a girl named $ZOE who is `also` in a long-distance relationship, she got so excited!
nodes.text_bbcode: Of course. When I told her that I met a girl named $ZOE who is [color=#e23b3b][i]also[/i][/color] in a long-distance relationship, she got so excited!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She... Did?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: When Matteo saw that picture of Howard, he must have assumed we're also staying together long-distance!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Definitely. She was so happy to know that I'd have someone to hang out with who isn't trying to date me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Yes. That is... Great.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If I don't tell him the truth about Howard now, I never will.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So what do I do?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: 'Overrated'?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm not saying you should go around lying all the time.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But sometimes, you need little lies just to get through hard times.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't `love` it that Howard used to wear the same shirt `every single day.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I didn't [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] it that Howard used to wear the same shirt [color=#3b78e2][i]every single day.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I never mentioned it to him. It just would have made him feel bad.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just like I'm sure Adrianna felt bad after hearing about all your female 'fans' here at school.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: That's actually a good point, signorina.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Perhaps in any relationship, some things are better left unsaid.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: For example, I didn't tell Adrianna how beautiful you are.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How... Beautiful I am?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Not... Not that it matters. Since we're both in relationships with other people.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: When Matteo saw that picture of Howard, he must have assumed we're also still together long-distance!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But it's like I said... The truth is overrated. We all need little white lies to get through the day.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Right... Not that it matters.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: So... Perhaps we should, as the Americans say, 'hang out' sometime?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes. 'Hanging out.' That would be nice.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: So what do you say, signorina... We meet after school?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I've been wanting to explore Paris, and I could use a partner-in-crime.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Count me in!
The next day at lunch, $ZOE spots Matteo sitting in a grassy field.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I wonder what's going on with Matteo... He looks upset.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess it wouldn't be `so` bad if I asked him what's wrong.
nodes.text_bbcode: I guess it wouldn't be [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] bad if I asked him what's wrong.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Matteo. Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Just a little sad to see this beautiful soccer field painted with these ugly lines.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh huh... You're right. What's going on?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Some of the `American` students lobbied the school to let them play `American` football here. Such a shame.
nodes.text_bbcode: Some of the [color=#e23b3b][i]American[/i][/color] students lobbied the school to let them play [color=#e23b3b][i]American[/i][/color] football here. Such a shame.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is that really everything that's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Well, there's also Adrianna. She was... Less than pleased to hear about the female attention I've been getting here.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You told her about that?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Some of the female students here started an online fan-club. Adrianna must have found out about it somehow.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Of course, I tell her everything anyway. Total and complete honesty... It's the only way any relationship can work.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Don't you agree?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess, in my opinion, honesty is...

nodes.prompt: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I was kind of worried he'd get the wrong idea about me, you know?

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: If you say so...
$ZOE looks back, and Matteo flashes her a smile.

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: But from the way you keep glancing back at him...

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: I'm beginning to suspect that your `own` feelings are the ones that you need to worry about!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm beginning to suspect that your [color=#3b78e2][i]own[/i][/color] feelings are the ones that you need to worry about!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What if she's right?! Am I being `totally` obvious?!
nodes.text_bbcode: What if she's right?! Am I being [color=#3b78e2][i]totally[/i][/color] obvious?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I must be pretty attracted to him if I'm trying so hard to stay away!
Despite herself, $ZOE realizes that she's looking in Matteo's direction.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So... Where are we anyway?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: At the world's finest art museum, of course.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Welcome to the Louvre.
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: This `huge` painting of a lake at sunset... It's one of my favorites.
nodes.text_bbcode: This [color=#e23b3b][i]huge[/i][/color] painting of a lake at sunset... It's one of my favorites.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: The sun glistening off the ripples of the lake... The dew hanging from the gentle blades of grass...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I can imagine Adrianna sitting in the field there, reading one of her favorite books.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It reminds me so much of the lake back home...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not that Centerscore is home anymore.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I can tell how much you miss it... How much you miss `him.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I can tell how much you miss it... How much you miss [color=#e23b3b][i]him.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I `do` miss Howard.
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]do[/i][/color] miss Howard.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But that doesn't mean I'm not enjoying being here with you.
Matteo looks down at $ZOE, deep into her eyes...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The way he's looking at me... Only Howard has ever looked at me that way before.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So... What do I do?

options.label: Move on to the next painting.

nodes.text: I wonder what's going on with Matteo... He looks upset.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess it wouldn't be `so` bad if I asked him what's wrong.
nodes.text_bbcode: I guess it wouldn't be [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] bad if I asked him what's wrong.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Matteo. Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Just a little sad to see this beautiful soccer field painted with these ugly lines.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh huh... You're right. What's going on?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Some of the `American` students lobbied the school to let them play `American` football here. Such a shame.
nodes.text_bbcode: Some of the [color=#e23b3b][i]American[/i][/color] students lobbied the school to let them play [color=#e23b3b][i]American[/i][/color] football here. Such a shame.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is that really everything that's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Well, there's also Adrianna. She was... Less than pleased to hear about the female attention I've been getting here.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You told her about that?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Some of the female students here started an online fan-club. Adrianna must have found out about it somehow.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Of course, I tell her everything anyway. Total and complete honesty... It's the only way any relationship can work.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Don't you agree?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess, in my opinion, honesty is...
The next day at school...

nodes.speaker: French Teacher
nodes.text: $ZOE... After talking to your mother and some of your classmates, we think that you're having trouble fitting in.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You've got that right.

nodes.speaker: French Teacher
nodes.text: But luckily for you, all is not lost...

nodes.speaker: French Teacher
nodes.text: We've got an `extra-special` class for students like you.
nodes.text_bbcode: We've got an [color=#3b78e2][i]extra-special[/i][/color] class for students like you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: 'Extra-special class'?

nodes.speaker: French Teacher
nodes.text: Exactly! The academic track isn't for everyone...

nodes.speaker: French Teacher
nodes.text: But that doesn't mean you can't learn a useful trade!
Some time later...
The mime pretends he is trapped in a glass box.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This was `way` more interesting for the first five weeks.
nodes.text_bbcode: This was [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] more interesting for the first five weeks.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Right. I know, I know. 'No talking in mime class.'
The mime nods his head... Then he pretends to climb a rope.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm starting to think I should have tried a little harder to fit in...
$ZOE, kicked out of regular school and sent to mime class?
This is no way to leave her! You'd better start over from the beginning and up your game!

args.text: Surviving High School
Try again!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Signorina... You came.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course... But what's going on? Last time we talked, you said that...
Matteo puts a finger to $ZOE's lips.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Shh...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: After we talked today, I called Adrianna...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: ...and I told her about `us.`
nodes.text_bbcode: ...and I told her about [color=#e23b3b][i]us.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: 'Us'?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: For the last few weeks, I've been trying to fight it, $ZOE. But now I understand.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Destiny led you to me... And me to you.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: You and Howard were `meant` to break up. Just as I was `meant` to break up with Adrianna today!
nodes.text_bbcode: You and Howard were [color=#e23b3b][i]meant[/i][/color] to break up. Just as I was [color=#e23b3b][i]meant[/i][/color] to break up with Adrianna today!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You broke up with Adrianna?!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: This is the way it was always meant to be, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Now there's no one to keep us apart. We're just two people. Nothing can separate us now.
He leans in, and $ZOE feels his breath, warm against her skin.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Matteo...
Matteo leans in and kisses her hard on the lips.
$ZOE does not resist...
And then a familiar voice echoes across the field.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE! NOOOOOOO!
Uh oh... It looks like someone may be here to separate $ZOE and Matteo after all!
But to find out what happens next, you'll have to check out the next episode!

args.text: Surviving High School
Thanks for playing!

nodes.text: A few minutes later, $ZOE stands alone in the center of the field.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't get it... Matteo said to meet here, but where is he?
Suddenly, the sprinklers come on!
$ZOE runs through the sprinklers and off of the field.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So... Cold....

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: Ho, ho, commoner. You fell for the oldest trick in the book!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Angelica?

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: You can't fool me with those sweet, plebeian eyes.

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: We've seen you on your 'dates' and 'hang-outs' with Matteo!

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: And `this` is what you get for trying to move in on `our` man!
nodes.text_bbcode: And [color=#3b78e2][i]this[/i][/color] is what you get for trying to move in on [color=#3b78e2][i]our[/i][/color] man!

nodes.text: Thirty others girls pour out from behind the bleachers. They're all holding water pistols.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What... What's going on? I'm already soaked!

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: With `water`. These squirt guns are filled with `sour milk.`
nodes.text_bbcode: With [color=#3b78e2][i]water[/i][/color]. These squirt guns are filled with [color=#3b78e2][i]sour milk.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But... But it's not fair. He rejected me, just like the rest of you!

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: Right... But `you` played with his heart. And for that... You must pay.
nodes.text_bbcode: Right... But [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] played with his heart. And for that... You must pay.

nodes.speaker: Angelica
nodes.text: Okay, girls. Ready... Aim... Fire!
The girls shoot Zoe with the spoiled milk.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So... Gross... So... Wrong!
Well, this stinks. Literally.
Do you really want to live in a world where $ZOE ends up smelling like old milk?
Play this over from the beginning... And make some better choices this time!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No problem, Lady Angelica.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: To be honest, I just didn't want to partner up with Matteo...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Overall... I guess it was kind of okay.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Oh, sweetie! That's good to hear. Did you make some new friends?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, kind of... There is this one boy.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: A `boy?`
nodes.text_bbcode: A [color=#3b78e2][i]boy?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He's just some guy. A potential boy-friend. Er, I mean, a friend-boy. I mean, just a friend!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Don't worry about it, sweetie. I'm sure you'll figure out what he is to you soon enough.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's happening to me? Why do I get so tongue-tied every time I think of Matteo?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's impossible that I have a crush on him, right? I've only been away from Howard for a few days!

nodes.title: French Kiss, Paris Part 2
nodes.subtitle: It's summer... And Paris is getting HOT!

nodes.text: In our last episode, $ZOE's friends raced to Paris to try to locate her...
But what has $ZOE been up to all this time?
Let's turn back the clock and see how she spent her days here in the City of Light!
It's summer in Paris. Flowers bloom. Happy couples walk hand-in-hand by the Seine. Laughter fills the air.
But not everyone is happy.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I'm not sure spending so much time at the computer is good for you, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry, Aunt Ca... Uh, I mean, Mom.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Er... Sorry about that. I'm just so used to talking to her about stuff... And you guys look `so` similar.
nodes.text_bbcode: Er... Sorry about that. I'm just so used to talking to her about stuff... And you guys look [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] similar.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Well, we `are` sisters.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, we [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] sisters.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Anyway, I'm just looking at a few photos people posted back in Centerscore...
$ZOE clicks on a photo to enlarge it... It's Howard talking to Jessica!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: They look awfully... Cozy.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Is that one of your friends, dear?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I thought he was my best friend...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But it sure seems like he got over me fast.
$ZOE clicks on another photo.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's Sam and all of her swim team friends at a sleepover!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess she's not missing me much either...

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Ring... Ring...
$ZOE's mom picks it up.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: It's your cousin Sam, $ZOE! She's calling you long-distance!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Tell her I don't want to talk.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: But $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, Mom. This is what I need.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've got to move on, just like everyone else has.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If I keep talking to them and looking at old photos, I'll just keep thinking about them all the time!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I understand, dear.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Sorry, Samantha. $ZOE needs some time to herself right now. I'm sure she'll call you back later... When she's ready.
She hangs up the phone.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: $ZOE... I understand that you want to distance yourself from your old friends right now.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: But I'm not sure it's necessarily healthy. What exactly are you trying to accomplish?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I want to...
